entities.name: José de Bustamante y Guerra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José de Bustamante y Guerra was a Spanish Navy officer, explorer and politician. He governed Guatemala as the captain general and president of the audiencia of Guatemala from 1811 to 1818. He governed Guatemala as a dictator and opposed the Cadiz Constitution of 1812.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José de Bustamante y Guerra was a Spanish Navy officer, explorer and politician. He governed Guatemala as the captain general and president of the audiencia of Guatemala from 1811 to 1818. He governed Guatemala as a dictator and opposed the Cadiz Constitution of 1812.
